lines.hanzi: 学一门外语很有用，也很有趣。
lines.pinyin: Xué yī mén wàiyǔ hěn yǒuyòng, yě hěn yǒuqù.
lines.english: Learning a foreign language is very useful and also interesting.

lines.hanzi: 我学英语学了很多年了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xué Yīngyǔ xué le hěn duō nián le.
lines.english: I've been learning English for many years.

lines.hanzi: 刚开始很难，单词记不住，语法不懂。
lines.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ hěn nán, dāncí jì bu zhù, yǔfǎ bù dǒng.
lines.english: At the beginning it was hard, couldn't remember words, didn't understand grammar.

lines.hanzi: 后来我每天坚持听、说、读、写。
lines.pinyin: Hòulái wǒ měitiān jiānchí tīng, shuō, dú, xiě.
lines.english: Later I persisted every day in listening, speaking, reading, writing.

lines.hanzi: 看英文电影，听英文歌，交外国朋友。
lines.pinyin: Kàn Yīngwén diànyǐng, tīng Yīngwén gē, jiāo wàiguó péngyou.
lines.english: Watch English movies, listen to English songs, make foreign friends.

lines.hanzi: 现在我能和外国人流利交流了。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ néng hé wàiguórén liúlì jiāoliú le.
lines.english: Now I can communicate fluently with foreigners.

lines.hanzi: 学外语不仅能找好工作，还能了解世界。
lines.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ bùjǐn néng zhǎo hǎo gōngzuò, hái néng liǎojiě shìjiè.
lines.english: Learning a foreign language not only helps find good jobs, but also understand the world.

lines.hanzi: 我想再学一门语言，也许是日语。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng zài xué yī mén yǔyán, yěxǔ shì Rìyǔ.
lines.english: I want to learn another language, maybe Japanese.

lines.hanzi: 不管学哪门语言，坚持最重要。
lines.pinyin: Bùguǎn xué nǎ mén yǔyán, jiānchí zuì zhòngyào.
lines.english: No matter which language, persistence is most important.
